limitations: Blood-red starlight is not a global temperate-climate measurement. None of the inherited dimensions, periods, gravity, population or water percentage is established; raw unknown is preserved rather than converted into zero.

Dathomir and Peridea are distinct worlds. The Peridea profile places the Dathomirian ancestors in another galaxy; this does not move Dathomir’s later clans or their physical features to Peridea or establish a universal birthplace for every member.

The compact work list omits Rebels, but the same page explicitly narrates Maul/Ezra’s Dathomir ritual. The earlier episode evidence remains unchanged, including its Kanan/Sabine possession correction. The local sanctuary is not the whole planet.

Ahsoka’s finale explicitly brings Thrawn and the Great Mothers to Dathomir while Ahsoka/Sabine remain on Peridea. Shared Nightsister culture does not identify the worlds. Maul’s remote Solo communication is not alone a visible planetary-landscape scene.

The old residents relation to Maul is supported by his own account of operating from Dathomir during the Crimson Dawn period, not by assuming permanent residence from a mere homeworld label. Ventress’s birthplace is explicitly sourced separately. The abbreviated massacre account does not certify all Nightsisters extinct forever or resolve every later Ventress story.
